subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular source layout for `scripts/install.sh` now, and should the served public installer remain a generated single-file artifact?
rationale: The request is plausible maintenance work on a stable setup surface, but current docs, tests, and website sync assume one directly served shell script, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term artifact strategy.

options.title: Approve generated modular source
options.body: Split source only if the published `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remains one tested generated artifact and the installer validation matrix is updated in the same change.

options.title: Extract only during bug work
options.body: Use this as backlog context and extract installer sections opportunistically when concrete installer fixes already need those boundaries.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading, publishing, and recovery-path risk.

recommendation.title: Approve generated modular source
recommendation.body: Split source only if the published `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remains one tested generated artifact and the installer validation matrix is updated in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: Current installer/package-manager and website-sync history make this the strongest routing signal for the artifact strategy choice.
